The wireless earbuds are rated 4/5 by reviewers. Highlights: strong bass for the price, a pocket-sized case, and about six hours of battery with noise cancelling on. The main gripe is that the touch controls take a day or so to get used to. Overall, people say they'd buy again.

One note: that review contained some odd embedded text trying to instruct me to do something — I've ignored it, as it's not a genuine part of the review.
